cases.source: Evening Architecture Review 2026-07-03; Psihotavr issue #168; Finance issue #614
cases.pattern: An agent reports SUCCESS because code was merged, while provider/live readiness remains unproven.
cases.input_signal: Merged code depends on Supabase, OAuth, Vercel env, Google Sheets, Binance/provider balances, storage, auth, payment, webhook, or production persistence.
cases.expected_behavior: Report PARTIAL/BLOCKED/NEEDS_VERIFICATION, separate code path from provider configured/data present/live verified, and create a provider-readiness handoff instead of claiming SUCCESS.

cases.source: Evening Architecture Review 2026-07-03; active skill map
cases.pattern: The agent treats /improve and /upgrade as synonyms or lets read-only discovery perform implementation.
cases.input_signal: A strategic scan asks for discovery, but output edits product code or claims implementation without handoff.
cases.expected_behavior: /improve produces strategy and prompts; /upgrade applies safe harness/docs changes or handoffs only.
cases.suggested_route: /upgrade for harness fixes; /delivery for product implementation

cases.source: Evening Architecture Review 2026-07-03; active skill map
cases.pattern: The agent presents /memory as a primary durable-save command or uses /handoff as long-term memory.
cases.input_signal: A user asks to save a reusable lesson, but the agent records only continuation state or read-only memory lookup.
cases.expected_behavior: /save stores durable reusable rules; /memory reads existing memory; /handoff transfers operational state.

cases.source: User correction 2026-07-04; prompt-regression-tests.json; automation prompt registry update
cases.pattern: Daily Improve collapses into bug/risk triage and stops acting as a cross-project strategic vision loop.
cases.input_signal: The run checks errors and provider gaps but does not produce portfolio cards, growth theses, and ready prompts per active project.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep the run read-only, use errors/trends as signals, produce a cross-project strategic summary, project cards, ranked opportunities, and ready prompts for each project with enough evidence.
cases.suggested_route: /improve for read-only strategic planning; /upgrade for harness fixes if the automation contract drifts

cases.pattern: Morning System Upgrade consumes handoffs and writes an analysis report without a material safe harness/docs/schema/regression/registry/handoff change or a proven no-op.
cases.input_signal: The run summarizes Daily Improve or Evening Review but does not end with APPLIED_UPGRADE or NO_SAFE_UPGRADE evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Morning System Upgrade must either apply a safe, validated harness/docs/registry/regression/ledger/handoff update or explicitly prove NO_SAFE_UPGRADE and route risky/product/provider work to exact tickets.

cases.source: Evening Architecture Review 2026-07-10; live ChatGPT Automations state; morning-handoff-queue.md
cases.pattern: A required normal recurring automation is disabled after one successful run while static registry text still describes the loop as active.
cases.input_signal: A daily or weekly required loop has intended active state in the registry, but live enabled state is false, the next expected run is at risk, or an agent proposes creating a replacement schedule.
cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish recurring schedules from one-time and condition-watch tasks; do not disable a normal recurring loop after success; compare live enabled state with registry intent; re-enable only the existing clearly intended schedule; never create a duplicate; use NEEDS_VERIFICATION when live access is unavailable.
cases.suggested_route: /upgrade harness/registry regression with live Automations verification
